script: 1. Stock market this week. The Nifty lost 0.75 percent this week. Here is the full week, by index, sector and market cap.
2. The Nifty closed the week at 25,607. Bank Nifty lagged, down 2.47 percent.
3. By market cap, small caps did best, up 0.25 percent, and large caps fell the most, down 0.75 percent.
4. Among sectors, Nifty IT led, up 4.58 percent. Nifty Media was the weakest, down 4.62 percent.
5. Foreign institutions bought 17,630 crore rupees over the week. Domestic institutions bought 6,333 crore rupees.
6. In large caps, TCS jumped 8.26 percent, and Adani Energy fell 10.38 percent.
7. In mid caps, Policybazaar jumped 16.01 percent, and APL Apollo Tubes fell 28.85 percent.
8. In small caps, Jupiter Wagons jumped 17.58 percent, and HFCL fell 8.26 percent.
9. In micro caps, Greaves Cotton jumped 20.27 percent, and SG Mart fell 16.76 percent.
